projects.title: WhatsApp OCR & Multi-Modal RAG Assistant
projects.description: An intelligent WhatsApp bot that processes scanned documents and images via OCR, indexes content into vector storage, and answers user queries using RAG
projects.fullDescription: Architected an end-to-end multi-modal solution that integrates WhatsApp Cloud API with an OCR and RAG pipeline. Users can send scanned PDFs, receipts, or document images directly via WhatsApp. The system processes the visual files using advanced OCR tools (like LlamaParse), generates vector embeddings, stores them in a vector database, and allows users to hold context-aware conversations and retrieve information from their documents in real-time
highlights: Utilizes high-precision OCR and LlamaParse engines to extract structured text and tables from complex documents
